headline: Confluence Cloud gains OAuth and deprecates v1 commands; identity.* modeling rules both land and revert
summary_md:
- **Atlassian Confluence Cloud** is the day: +2,969/-439 lines for new OAuth authentication and v2 commands, with the v1 commands deprecated (#45378).
- The `identity.*` modeling-rule series moves in both directions — PR 6 of 7 lands (#45461) while PR 2 of 7 is reverted (#45558).
- Four packs shrink sharply: **GuardiCore** (-963), **Silverfort** (-178), **CommvaultBackupSolutions** (-121) and **CitrixADC** (-112).
- Five packs are addition-only, led by **MicrosoftWindowsEvents** (+318), and seven more carry an identical +9/-2 bump.

highlights.title: Atlassian Confluence Cloud deprecates its v1 commands
highlights.detail: The pack adds OAuth authentication and a v2 command set and deprecates the v1 commands, at +2,969/-439 lines — by far the largest change of the day.

highlights.title: The identity.* modeling-rule series lands one PR and reverts another
highlights.detail: PR 6 of 7 (#45461) is merged the same day PR 2 of 7 is reverted (#45558), and a separate commit corrects a rule version token from 3_19 to 2_11 (#45505).

highlights.title: GuardiCore and Silverfort are cut back in a single bump
highlights.detail: GuardiCore loses 963 lines and Silverfort 178, both under one commit (#45564); CommvaultBackupSolutions (-121) and CitrixADC (-112) shrink the same way without a commit subject naming them.

highlights.title: SOCRadar's v2 feed files are renamed
highlights.detail: FeedSOCRadarThreatFeed v2 files are renamed under the SOCRadar pack (#45512), touching both packs.

highlights.title: Seven packs carry an identical +9/-2 bump
highlights.detail: AzureDevOps, Barracuda CloudGen Firewall, BeyondTrust Remote Support, CybelAngel, FeedSOCRadarThreatFeed, Fortinet FortiWeb VM and NetMotion VPN all move by the same two-line shape.

items.Packs/AtlassianConfluenceCloud: The day's largest change at +2,969/-439: new OAuth authentication, new v2 commands, and deprecation of the v1 commands (#45378).
items.Packs/GuardiCore: Loses 963 lines against 5 added, in the commit that bumps GuardiCore and Silverfort together (#45564).
items.Packs/Silverfort: Loses 178 lines against 5 added, bumped alongside GuardiCore (#45564).
items.Packs/CommvaultBackupSolutions: Drops 121 lines and adds 1; no commit subject names the pack.
items.Packs/CitrixADC: Drops 112 lines and adds 1, the same shape as CommvaultBackupSolutions.
items.Packs/MicrosoftWindowsEvents: Gains 318 lines against a single deletion — the largest addition-only change of the day.
items.Packs/DelineaSS: Gains 103 lines against a single deletion.
items.Packs/ApiModules: +97/-13 in the shared API module code.
items.Packs/McAfeeWebGateway: Gains 86 lines against a single deletion.
items.Packs/ProofpointCasb: Gains 70 lines against a single deletion.
items.Packs/ManageEngine-ADSelfServicePlus: Gains 62 lines against a single deletion.
items.Packs/SOCRadar: +22/-16, receiving the FeedSOCRadarThreatFeed v2 files under a rename (#45512).
items.Packs/McAfee-TIE: Removes a no-op statement and adds debug logging to the DXL configuration (#45552).
items.Packs/FeedSOCRadarThreatFeed: Carries the +9/-2 bump; its v2 files were renamed into the SOCRadar pack (#45512).
